title: Smart search in the service history
questionLabel: Type your question about truck maintenance
placeholder: e.g. when were the brake pads last changed?
thinking: Searching the service history… this can take half a minute
keyNeeded: Smart search is not switched on yet — ask the office
empty: Ask anything about the service history
canAnswerHistory: Work done on a truck before: when, at what odometer, and what was written.
canAnswerWords: Use your own words — it knows that “pads”, “brakes” and “discs” are related.
canAnswerCounts: Counting and comparing too: how many times, which truck the most, totals…
cannotAnswerCounts: Counting and comparing questions (how many, which truck the most…) are for supervisors only — your account can search the history.
needsInternet: This search needs an internet connection.
blockedTitle: This question needs a supervisor account
blockedBody: Counting and comparing questions (how many, most, total…) can only be asked by a supervisor. You can ask about specific work on a truck, like “last oil change for truck…”, or ask a supervisor to run this one.
errOffline: No connection — smart search needs the internet. Try again when it is back.
errPermission: Your account is not allowed to use this search — ask a supervisor.
errNotSetUp: Smart search is not switched on yet — ask the office.
errBusy: Too many questions in a short time — wait a few minutes and try again.
noHits: No matching work found — try other words, or only the plate
noAnswer: No answer found for this question — try asking it another way.
advisorDown: The service-history search is unavailable right now, so this is an approximate answer from the data.
noHitsFellBack: No matching service line was found, so the question was answered from the data directly.
